facts.fact: UNDP Kenya says a digital and AI skilling programme for public servants, led by the Government of Kenya with UNDP and Microsoft and implemented by the Kenya School of Government, was first launched in December 2024 and its four-level curriculum was validated at a workshop on 30 July 2025.
facts.system: Africa Centre of Competence for Digital and AI Skilling

systems.system: Africa Centre of Competence for Digital and AI Skilling

KEN.note: The programme described trains civil servants only, not the public.
The National Digital Master Plan 2022-2032 is named only as an alignment; the document states nothing on its standing, text, plan or reporting.
The validation workshop names officials, UNDP and Microsoft, and no one from outside government.
Nothing on secondary schools or their internet.
